metadata.description: Rumor stack plugin marketplace for Claude Code

plugins.name: rumor-ui
plugins.description: Figma -> code, the Rumor way. Turns a Figma frame into a standards-compliant, tested, verified UI screen in rumor-mobile-expo, with backend contract probing, an auto-enforcing standards hook, and a self-improving lessons ledger.

plugins.name: thermos
plugins.description: Thermo-nuclear branch review: deep correctness/security audits and harsh code-quality rubrics with parallel subagents.

plugins.name: ralph-wiggum
plugins.description: Autonomous AI agent loop that runs Claude Code repeatedly until all PRD items are complete. Each iteration spawns a fresh instance with clean context; memory persists via git history, progress.txt, and prd.json.

plugins.name: vercel
plugins.description: Vercel's official MCP server — manage projects and deployments and read build/runtime logs from Claude Code.
